story.title: On curiosity fell 62% (81,603 → 30,692) (vs the 28 days before)
paragraphs: How many people look up “On (company)” on Wikipedia each day. It is a free, public stand-in for search interest: when curiosity spikes, pageviews usually spike too.

Why it might matter for On Holding: on is a fast-growing brand, and its growth depends on more people discovering its shoes. Rising curiosity is an early hint of new customers; a fade suggests the buzz is cooling.
What it shows now: public curiosity about On is fading.
Test status: Tested: no predictive power found. In our backtest this signal did not predict the stock better than chance.

trackLine: In our backtest (Jan 2023–Oct 2026), the stock moved the way the lean pointed over the next month 49.3% of the time (522 of 1058). Beat the market (did it do better than the S&P 500 over the same month, the tougher test): 49% (515 of 1050). That's about a coin flip, so treat these as conversation starters, not predictions.
